# BhoomiMitra (भू-मित्र) — Property Marketplace Across India (Full Specification)

> BhoomiMitra is an India-focused property marketplace for sale, rent, and lease. Individuals, companies, and agents can submit eligible property listings, while buyers and tenants can contact the listed seller directly. BhoomiMitra currently charges no platform listing fee and 0% platform brokerage.

BhoomiMitra supports property discovery across India, including residential plots, apartments, houses, villas, commercial spaces, industrial properties, hospitality properties, agricultural land, farm plots, and related categories.

Core marketplace principles:
- Seller types: Individual, Company, or Agent.
- Direct contact: buyers and tenants can contact the listed seller directly.
- Current platform listing fee: ₹0.
- Platform brokerage: BhoomiMitra charges 0% platform brokerage and no transaction success fee.
- Review model: submitted listings follow validation, anti-spam, moderation, and review workflows before approved listings become publicly visible.
- Verification limitation: a BhoomiMitra review or listing status does not guarantee title, ownership, legality, approvals, boundaries, encumbrance status, valuation, or suitability.
- Payments: BhoomiMitra currently does not collect property purchase payments, booking amounts, rent, deposits, sale consideration, brokerage, or marketplace listing fees through the property transaction flow.
- Due diligence: buyers should independently verify legal title, registration records, approvals, physical boundaries, measurements, access, and other property details before entering into a transaction.

Indian Land Measurement Conversions:
- 1 Square Yard = 1 sq. yd (9 sq. ft)
- 1 Gunta = 121 sq. yds
- 1 Cent = 48.4 sq. yds
- 1 Acre = 4,840 sq. yds (40 Guntas / 100 Cents)
- 1 Hectare = 11,959.9 sq. yds (2.471 Acres)
- 1 Bigha varies by region and should not be treated as a single national standard.

## Key Public Routes

- [Marketplace Homepage](https://bhoomimitra.com/): Property search, marketplace highlights, featured listings, land-area tools, and buyer due-diligence guidance.
- [Find Property](https://bhoomimitra.com/buy): Property explorer with category, transaction, location, price, and area filters.
- [Post Property](https://bhoomimitra.com/sell): Multi-step listing creator for eligible Individual, Company, and Agent sellers. Current platform listing fee is ₹0; submitted listings follow the platform review workflow.
- [About BhoomiMitra](https://bhoomimitra.com/about): Marketplace mission, seller model, direct seller contact, and fee approach.
- [Customer Support](https://bhoomimitra.com/contact): Customer support and grievance redressal.
- [Listing Rules](https://bhoomimitra.com/listing-rules): Seller standards, declarations, moderation, prohibited listings, and buyer due-diligence notices.
- [Terms of Service](https://bhoomimitra.com/terms): Platform terms, payment limitations, user obligations, and liability disclaimers.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bhoomimitra.com/privacy): Data handling, privacy, account information, and user rights.
- [Refund Policy](https://bhoomimitra.com/refund-policy): Current policy for a marketplace that does not collect listing or property transaction payments.

## Core Features & Tools

- [Land Area Converter](https://bhoomimitra.com/#converter): Indian land unit converter across Guntas, Cents, Acres, Square Yards, and Hectares.
- [Buyer Due Diligence](https://bhoomimitra.com/listing-rules): Guidance for reviewing deeds, encumbrance records, revenue records, survey information, approvals, and physical property details.
- [Interactive Property Search](https://bhoomimitra.com/buy): Search and filtering across supported property categories and transaction types.
